Subject: CS -> Implementation: Installation manifest & network review (Vitality Health)

Hi Samir —

Great to meet yesterday. Per our success plan, we need to move the technical handoff to implementation so we can lock the install window and the networking configuration for your private deployment. I attached the preliminary installation-manifest (installation-manifest_vitality_v1.xlsx) with the items we typically validate ahead of an on-prem / VPC peering rollout.

Primary asks from CS to get started: 
- Confirm whether you prefer VPC Peering or PrivateLink for host connectivity (we recommend VPC Peering for reduced NAT complexity).
- Provide public firewall egress IP ranges and ASN for routing and allowlist.
- Confirm preferred maintenance window (dates/timezone).
- Point of contact for network & security (name + email + phone).
- Whether you require KMS/HSM integration and SSO/IdP details.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Implementation deep-dive this Thursday (30 min) to walk through the manifest and ownership.
2) Implementation team runs preflight checklist and schedules an on-site/remote install block (3-5 hours).
3) Execute a canary test with one service for 24 hours before full cutover.

If possible please send the network contact and IP ranges by EOD Wednesday so Monica can prepare the VPC peering checklist.

Thanks — I’m looping in the implementation leads.

— Rafael

Thanks Rafael — sharing a few notes from the implementation side. I attached our VPC peering checklist (vpc-peering-checklist.pdf) that we use to validate provisions; contains the exact CIDR and routing checks we'll run.

Questions to clarify before the deep-dive: 
- Do you plan for cross-account VPC peering (Redwood-managed VPC) or will Vitality create a customer VPC and we peer into it?
- Is there an internal NAT/egress gateway that will perform SNAT, or do you want our hosted egress IPs used?
- Any IP allowlist constraints on subnets (e.g., only specific AZs)?
- Do you have a transit gateway in your environment? If yes, provide the TGW ID.

Proposed time for the 30-min deep-dive: Thu Aug 27 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET. If that works for Samir and the network team I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (manifest walkthrough + open network items + action owners).
